## As seen in

"Through a series of iterations, the concept was turned into XStat, a dose of tiny sponge-like discs
that are injected into an open wound with a syringe. The sponges, which have been treated with an
anti-hemorrhagic substance, expand to 10 times their size in seconds, both plugging the wound and
providing needed compression to stanch the bleeding." — CNN
"Following an incident like a shooting, natural disaster, or car accident, the time XStat trims to
stop bleeding can then be spent assessing other vitals. 'In the hands of the appropriately trained
medical professional, this device would be an intervention and can keep somebody alive long enough
to get them to the ER,' " — CBS News
"The patient’s bleeding was initially stopped by a tourniquet, according to a report by the
military. But there was residual bleeding during a nearly seven-hour operation by a U.S. military
forward surgical team. 'Eventually, the FST team opted to use XSTAT and applied a single XSTAT
device…resulting in nearly immediate hemostasis.' " — PBS NewsHour

## Featured as a PBS Breakthrough

### FAQ

Who can buy XSTAT?

Licensed medical professionals or first responders with a relevant license. Use simple, online form
to get approved quickly.

forward surgical team. 'Eventually, the FST team opted to use XSTAT and applied a single XSTAT
device…resulting in nearly immediate hemostasis.' " — PBS NewsHour

## Featured as a PBS Breakthrough

### FAQ

Who can buy XSTAT?

Licensed medical professionals or first responders with a relevant license. Use simple, online form
to get approved quickly.

We also sell over the counter products ready for immediate shipment, like our [Airwrap Compression
Wrap][80] or our [TX line of ratcheting tourniquets.][81]

How do XSTAT® sponges stop bleeding so quickly?

The small cellulose-based minisponges expand up to 10× their compressed size within seconds of
contact with blood, filling the cavity and exerting hemostatic pressure to stop bleeding rapidly.

What happens when the minisponges need to be removed?

The **entire pouch** containing the expanded sponges is designed to be removed in one piece during
surgery. Radiopaque markers within the pouch help confirm full retrieval using X-ray or fluoroscopy.

Training resources?

Browse our [free instructional videos and downloadable IFU documents][82] to enhance your
understanding of our products.

Which RevMedx products are CoTCCC recommended?

XSTAT and TX tourniquets are [Recommended by the Committee on Tactical Combat Casualty Care][83]
(CoTCCC) and field-tested by US Special Operations Forces for over a decade.

# Emergency Medicine Physicians

In early 2015, North Canton-based Emergency Medicine Physicians (EMP) entered into an agreement with
funding partner, Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe, to form USACS, the national leader in
Physician-owned Integrated Acute Care. With the monumental market and regulatory shifts happening in
healthcare, forming USACS was the right move at the right time for the Physician group.

[ Contact Us arrow_forward_ios ][92]

## Becoming a World-Class Group

Now with the right capital partner, EMP has the necessary resources and experience to support growth
and ensure long-term future success. By joining a Physician-owned and led group with national scope,
EMP is better positioned to hire the best Physicians and Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in the
country, expand its solution offerings, and compete directly with large, publicly-owned healthcare
groups.

 

#### Building a Strong Foundation

When it came time to develop the new USACS model, it was important for EMP to assemble a group that
shared its values of "[Servant’s Heart. Owner’s Mind."][93] – a mantra now guiding USACS. EMP sought
out other Physician groups with a commitment to Physician ownership and patient-centered care, now
known as the USACS founding partners.

 

#### Since Founding USACS

In the time since founding USACS, EMP’s [PhysicianFirst][94] Emergency Department management system
has grown to reach a national audience and serve the needs of many USACS hospital partners.
Additionally, the [Patient Satisfaction Academy][95] and [Scholars Programs][96] have been leveraged
to deliver meaningful education and training for Physicians and APPs throughout the company.

# Emergency Medicine Physicians

In early 2015, North Canton-based Emergency Medicine Physicians (EMP) entered into an agreement with
funding partner, Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe, to form USACS, the national leader in
Physician-owned Integrated Acute Care. With the monumental market and regulatory shifts happening in
healthcare, forming USACS was the right move at the right time for the Physician group.

[ Contact Us arrow_forward_ios ][92]

## Becoming a World-Class Group

Now with the right capital partner, EMP has the necessary resources and experience to support growth
and ensure long-term future success. By joining a Physician-owned and led group with national scope,
EMP is better positioned to hire the best Physicians and Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in the
country, expand its solution offerings, and compete directly with large, publicly-owned healthcare
groups.

 

#### Building a Strong Foundation

When it came time to develop the new USACS model, it was important for EMP to assemble a group that
shared its values of "[Servant’s Heart. Owner’s Mind."][93] – a mantra now guiding USACS. EMP sought
out other Physician groups with a commitment to Physician ownership and patient-centered care, now
known as the USACS founding partners.

 

#### Since Founding USACS

In the time since founding USACS, EMP’s [PhysicianFirst][94] Emergency Department management system
has grown to reach a national audience and serve the needs of many USACS hospital partners.
Additionally, the [Patient Satisfaction Academy][95] and [Scholars Programs][96] have been leveraged
to deliver meaningful education and training for Physicians and APPs throughout the company.

Now with the right capital partner, EMP has the necessary resources and experience to support growth
and ensure long-term future success. By joining a Physician-owned and led group with national scope,
EMP is better positioned to hire the best Physicians and Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in the
country, expand its solution offerings, and compete directly with large, publicly-owned healthcare
groups.

 

#### Building a Strong Foundation

When it came time to develop the new USACS model, it was important for EMP to assemble a group that
shared its values of "[Servant’s Heart. Owner’s Mind."][93] – a mantra now guiding USACS. EMP sought
out other Physician groups with a commitment to Physician ownership and patient-centered care, now
known as the USACS founding partners.

 

#### Since Founding USACS

In the time since founding USACS, EMP’s [PhysicianFirst][94] Emergency Department management system
has grown to reach a national audience and serve the needs of many USACS hospital partners.
Additionally, the [Patient Satisfaction Academy][95] and [Scholars Programs][96] have been leveraged
to deliver meaningful education and training for Physicians and APPs throughout the company.

## Featured as a PBS Breakthrough

### FAQ

Who can buy XSTAT?

Licensed medical professionals or first responders with a relevant license. Use simple, online form
to get approved quickly.

We also sell over the counter products ready for immediate shipment, like our [Airwrap Compression
Wrap][80] or our [TX line of ratcheting tourniquets.][81]

How do XSTAT® sponges stop bleeding so quickly?

The small cellulose-based minisponges expand up to 10× their compressed size within seconds of
contact with blood, filling the cavity and exerting hemostatic pressure to stop bleeding rapidly.

What happens when the minisponges need to be removed?

The **entire pouch** containing the expanded sponges is designed to be removed in one piece during
surgery. Radiopaque markers within the pouch help confirm full retrieval using X-ray or fluoroscopy.

Training resources?

Browse our [free instructional videos and downloadable IFU documents][82] to enhance your
understanding of our products.

Which RevMedx products are CoTCCC recommended?

XSTAT and TX tourniquets are [Recommended by the Committee on Tactical Combat Casualty Care][83]
(CoTCCC) and field-tested by US Special Operations Forces for over a decade.

A proprietary technology, which consists of a non-woven material impregnated with Kaolin. Kaolin
activates Factor XII,¹ which in turn accelerates the clotting cascade^{2,3,4,5} leading to faster
bleeding control.^{8,9,10}

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans
and choose the international expat healthcare cover that’s perfect for you. Only away for less than
a year? Discover our short-term private health insurance for individuals and families.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## Welcome To

# Assured Safety & Training (AST)

Compliance-Driven EHS & Quality Oversight for Industrial Operations

Assured Safety & Training (AST) is a locally owned Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) and quality
oversight company serving industrial, construction, and manufacturing clients.

AST was built to deliver structured, field-capable support where compliance and operational control
are critical. We provide professional EHS oversight, emergency support services, and quality control
solutions aligned with OSHA regulations, NFPA guidance, and recognized industry standards.

We don’t operate as a generic safety provider. We integrate directly into client operations, support
leadership teams, and take command in high-risk environments.

## About Us

Assured Safety & Training (AST) was founded to provide professional Environmental, Health & Safety
(EHS), quality oversight, and emergency support services to industrial and construction operations.

 

We believe safety is more than compliance — it is a commitment to protecting people, sustaining
operations, and preparing organizations for the unexpected. Many programs look sufficient on paper
but struggle under real-world conditions. AST exists to ensure that systems perform when they are
needed most.

 

Our approach is built on operational experience, regulatory knowledge, and a genuine dedication to
the organizations we serve. We work alongside EHS managers, plant leadership, project managers, and
contractors — not just as consultants, but as partners invested in the success and resilience of
their operations.

 

When challenges arise, we are there to support the process, strengthen the response, and help teams
move forward with confidence.

[Learn More][8]

## Professional EHS & Quality Oversight Services

Assured Safety & Training (AST) provides scalable Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS), emergency
response support, and quality oversight services tailored to industrial, construction, and
manufacturing environments.

* OSHA-aligned compliance audits

* Corrective action tracking and documentation


AST identifies compliance gaps and provides structured implementation support.

## EHS Program Development

We develop practical, operation-ready programs including:
 
* Injury & Illness Prevention Programs (IIPP)
* Hazard Communication (HazCom)
* Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)
* Fall Protection Plans
* Confined Space Programs
* Emergency Action Plans (EAP)
* Site-specific safety manuals


Programs are customized to the client’s operational risks and regulatory requirements.

wounds.

## Our Mission


We are Calon Hearts UK, Wales's leading heart screening and defibrillator charity. We're on a
mission to ensure that every community across Wales has a defibrillator, that more people are
CPR-trained and that everyone has access to our heart screening programme. This is because today in
the UK, 480 people will die from a heart attack or circulatory disease. And at least 12 seemingly
healthy young people die every week in the UK from an undiagnosed heart condition. Our mission is
simple: to reduce this number so that no family loses a loved one to a heart condition that could
have been detected and managed. We’re committed to providing services that help minimise the risk of
people dying due to an unknown heart condition.

## Our Services


Accessibility to a defibrillator is key to saving a life. Each minute that is wasted reduces the
chances of saving that life by 10%. Therefore, it is our mission to ensure that nobody is further
than 100 metres away from a fully working publicly accessible defibrillator.

In order to fulfil this mission, we need your support to place more of these lifesaving devices
throughout the country.

## Heart Screening


Calon Hearts, through its charitable heart screening programme, has already established the benefit
of screening, having identified many people with life-changing and life-limiting cardiac conditions.
As part of a strategic reorganisation, Calon Hearts is going to continue this important work to save
lives throughout the country.

## Latest News

Keep up to date with the latest from Calon Hearts. From upcoming screening events and charity
initiatives to stories from the communities we support, this is where we share news about our work
helping to keep more hearts beating.

At least 12 seemingly healthy young people die every week in the UK from heart conditions they
didn’t even know they had. Our mission is simple; to reduce this number so that no family loses a
loved one to a heart condition that could have been detected and managed.

Calon Hearts, through its charitable heart screening programme, has already established the benefit
of screening, having identified many people with life-changing and life-limiting cardiac conditions.
As part of a strategic reorganisation, Calon Hearts is going to continue this important work to save
lives  throughout the country.

[Book Now][53]

**Sudden Cardiac Death in the young is an under-recognised health problem and tragedy in the UK. It
is estimated that at least 12 deaths per week are a result of SCD in the young. Furthermore, a
significant proportion of these deaths are preventable by simple screening with an ECG and
echocardiogram. **

safeguards against emerging perils. Develop operational resilience with us.

# In less than one hour, anyone can learn
# how to stop life-threatening bleeding.

[Learn more][14]

STOP THE BLEED^{®}is an official program of the U.S. Department of Defense

The program is designed to train and equip the public to be able to treat traumatic injuries
involving severe bleeding until the first responders arrive.

The program is based on lessons learned by the DoD during the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan on how
best to control severe bleeding.

## Know How to Take Action

[Be the First to Act in Emergencies]

### Be the First to Act in Emergencies

No matter how fast professional emergency responders arrive, bystanders will always be first on the
scene. 

[Every Minute Counts]

### Every Minute Counts

A person experiencing life-threatening bleeding can die from blood loss within minutes, before first
responders arrive.

[Anyone Can Learn]

### Anyone Can Learn

A bystander with STOP THE BLEED^{®} training can slow or stop blood loss to keep someone alive until
first responders arrive.

[STOP THE BLEED®]

## Why It’s Important?

### 3-5 minutes

Someone can bleed out within minutes.

### 7-10 minutes

**Urban first responder** arrival can take up to 15 minutes.

### 30-45 minutes

**Rural first responder** arrival can take up to 45 minutes.

### 40%

Trauma-related deaths worldwide due to bleeding out.

### #1

**The number 1 cause** of preventable death after injury is bleeding.

### STOP THE BLEED^{®} is Worldwide

Training offered in **165 countries**.

## Life-Threatening Bleeding Can Happen Anytime, Anywhere

### Battlefield Insights

STOP THE BLEED^{®} is based upon lessons learned on the **battlefields of Iraq and Afghanistan** on
how best to control bleeding. [Battlefield Insights]

### Leading in Trauma Care

Today, DoD is a world leader in researching how best to provide for the immediate stabilization of
combat casualties, including how to treat **traumatic injuries** involving severe blood loss.
[Leading in Trauma Care]

### Military Lessons for Resilience

STOP THE BLEED^{®} is another example of military lessons used to help foster national resilience

## When We See You, We See Us.

Our health is one of the most personal things in our lives. The care you receive should feel
personal too. At Orlando Health, we deliver the kind of care we would want for ourselves or our
loved ones. It’s how we listen, guide, explain, and stay committed.

## Our Partners

Trust the team that cares for yours. We are official medical providers and healthcare partners for a
variety of professional, college, community and high school teams.

Empower your team with life-saving skills. From situational awareness to Stop the Bleed techniques —
military-trained instructors prepare your organization to respond when every second counts.

emergency care with tactical situational awareness — so your staff can save lives before EMS
arrives.

## What Is AVIRT? Active Violence Immediate Response Training

AVIRT (Active Violence Immediate Response Training) is the evolution of active shooter response.
Unlike outdated "run-hide-fight" protocols, AVIRT equips your team with an immediate, decisive
action framework — including critical Stop the Bleed medical intervention.

01
Situational Awareness & Recognition

Identify warning signs, behavioral cues, and environmental threats before violence escalates.

02
Immediate Decision-Making Framework

Move beyond passive response. Train your team to make split-second decisions that save lives.

03
Stop the Bleed Medical Response

Tourniquet application, wound packing, and hemorrhage control — the skills that bridge the gap
before EMS arrives.

04
Scenario-Based Live Exercises

Hands-on drills in realistic scenarios that build muscle memory and confidence under pressure.

Beginning in the United States as a public health campaign, STOP THE BLEED^{®} has expanded to more
than 170 countries.

The STOP THE BLEED^{®} Project was founded to develop programs that engage people and organizations
so they get involved and take action.

Stay Informed

## Programs of the STOP THE BLEED^{®} Project

### Ambassador Program

Are you passionate about STOP THE BLEED®? Help us to engage your community about the importance of
learning about how to save the life of someone who is traumatically bleeding by becoming a STOP THE
BLEED® Ambassador.

[View More][29]

### STOP THE BLEED^{®} Day

Thanks to everyone who helped make STOP THE BLEED® Day 2025 a great success!

And please mark **May 21, 2026** for the next STOP THE BLEED® Day!

[View More][30]

### STOP THE BLEED^{®} Trainathon and STOP THE BLEED^{®} Month

The Trainathon is a month-long call to action for the public to take an approved STOP THE BLEED^{®}
training course during May 2026, National STOP THE BLEED^{®} Month.

Approved STOP THE BLEED^{®} instructors can register classes they plan to teach on the STOP THE
BLEED^{®} Training Platform so people can sign up and take their class.

[Trainathon][31]
[STB Month][32]

### Grant Program

The STOP THE BLEED^{®} Grant Program, now in its 8th year, has awarded STOP THE BLEED^{®}  Training
Equipment grants to organizations across the United States.

[View More][33]

### Would You Know

Use our posters to spread the word and have people thinking about what to do if someone has
life-threatening bleeding.

[View More][34]

### Podcast

Listen to the STOP THE BLEED® podcasts and hear from leaders and participants in this major public
health campaign.

[View More][35]

### Raise Your Hand

Create awareness of STOP THE BLEED® through the Raise Your Hand campaign.

Use our Hand signs and your own photos to promote STOP THE BLEED through social media and your
networks.

[View More][36]

# The Minutes Matter Project

### Helping bystanders stop blood loss and save lives

## Did you know?

#### **A person can bleed to death in as little as 3 to 5 minutes.**

Most people don't know that. They assume there's time —
time to call 911, time to wait, time for help to arrive.

But in rural areas like the Mendocino coast, EMS response can take 20 minutes or more.

That gap is the whole reason this project exists.

[James and Chloe, the founders of the non-profit]
[James and Chloe, the founders of the non-profit]

### Who we are

The Minutes Matter Project is a Mendocino County nonprofit founded by a local ER nurse, Chloe, and
her husband, James, an avid surfer and beloved high school English teacher. We're a small,
community-rooted team working to make sure help is never too far away, even in the most remote
corners of our coastline.

#### Our Mission

Serious injuries can happen anywhere on the Mendocino coast — on a hiking trail, at the beach, out
on the water — often in places where help is 30 minutes away. In those moments, the person closest
to the injury has the power to save a life, long before an ambulance can arrive.

The Minutes Matter Project places bleeding control kits at the most highly trafficked beaches on the
Mendocino Coast. Our kits are simple and easy to understand — no medical background required. With
the right supplies and a little confidence, anyone can stop a bleed and save a life.

The Minutes Matter Project is a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt nonprofit organization.
EIN: 42-3533712. Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.

## Our "Be The Help" Campaign Supports U.S. Veterans and Pediatric Cancer Survivors

We carry Trauma Kits and emergency medical supplies produced by Military Veteran owned companies,
and all proceeds fund rehabilitation therapies for children severely affected by cancer and brain
tumors. Foundation ThinkAgain! is a 501c3  non-profit organization in operation since 2008...
because children can't fight the effects of cancer alone. 

#### Why Do We Need Public Access Emergency Response Trauma Kits?

The Department of Homeland Security's "STOP THE BLEED"  and FEMA's "BE THE HELP" campaigns, were
launched to encourage bystanders to step in and give aid, because sometimes injuries are too serious
to wait for help. Our trauma kits are built with tccc approved products and provide simple
instructions. We have first aid for schools, first aid for the workplace, and first aid for homes.
We carry stop the bleed kits, kits for law enforcement, kits to carry on a school bus, kits for work
safety and kits for storefronts and other businesses. Feel free to [**contact us**][44] to help you
choose an affordable, yet effective trauma kit for your organization. 

ThinkTraumaKits.com is a distributor of TRAMEDIC RESPONSE SYSTEMS, TACTICAL MEDICAL SOLUTIONS, NORTH
AMERICAN RESCUE and PHOKUS RESEARCH GROUP; all USA Veteran-Owned enterprises.

# One Kit at a Time

### Training

Our team of medical professionals come to
your school

### Safety & Security

We want you to feel ready for any emergency and
hope you never have to use your training

### Kits

[**Each kit contains:**][20]
Gloves
Tourniquet
Permanent Marker
Medical Scissors
Gauze
Instruction Card

We provide education and hands on training to school staff on identifying and treating life
threatening bleeding. Once training is complete,
we provide bleeding control kits to campuses.

### What can you do?

Our program operates on donations.

> being more prepared.””

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

disparities, and health outcomes in communities and populations worldwide, including the impact of
social conditions on the composition of patients seeking care in emergency departments. **][192]

###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

###

and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

# Assured Safety & Training (AST)

Compliance-Driven EHS & Quality Oversight for Industrial Operations

Assured Safety & Training (AST) is a locally owned Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) and quality
oversight company serving industrial, construction, and manufacturing clients.

AST was built to deliver structured, field-capable support where compliance and operational control
are critical. We provide professional EHS oversight, emergency support services, and quality control
solutions aligned with OSHA regulations, NFPA guidance, and recognized industry standards.

We don’t operate as a generic safety provider. We integrate directly into client operations, support
leadership teams, and take command in high-risk environments.

## About Us

Assured Safety & Training (AST) was founded to provide professional Environmental, Health & Safety
(EHS), quality oversight, and emergency support services to industrial and construction operations.

 

We believe safety is more than compliance — it is a commitment to protecting people, sustaining
operations, and preparing organizations for the unexpected. Many programs look sufficient on paper
but struggle under real-world conditions. AST exists to ensure that systems perform when they are
needed most.

 

Our approach is built on operational experience, regulatory knowledge, and a genuine dedication to
the organizations we serve. We work alongside EHS managers, plant leadership, project managers, and
contractors — not just as consultants, but as partners invested in the success and resilience of
their operations.

 

When challenges arise, we are there to support the process, strengthen the response, and help teams
move forward with confidence.

[Learn More][8]

## Professional EHS & Quality Oversight Services

Assured Safety & Training (AST) provides scalable Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS), emergency
response support, and quality oversight services tailored to industrial, construction, and
manufacturing environments.

We develop practical, operation-ready programs including:

* Emergency Action Plans (EAP)
* Site-specific safety manuals


Programs are customized to the client’s operational risks and regulatory requirements.

## Our Mission


We are Calon Hearts UK, Wales's leading heart screening and defibrillator charity. We're on a
mission to ensure that every community across Wales has a defibrillator, that more people are
CPR-trained and that everyone has access to our heart screening programme. This is because today in
the UK, 480 people will die from a heart attack or circulatory disease. And at least 12 seemingly
healthy young people die every week in the UK from an undiagnosed heart condition. Our mission is
simple: to reduce this number so that no family loses a loved one to a heart condition that could
have been detected and managed. We’re committed to providing services that help minimise the risk of
people dying due to an unknown heart condition.

## Our Services


Accessibility to a defibrillator is key to saving a life. Each minute that is wasted reduces the
chances of saving that life by 10%. Therefore, it is our mission to ensure that nobody is further
than 100 metres away from a fully working publicly accessible defibrillator.

In order to fulfil this mission, we need your support to place more of these lifesaving devices
throughout the country.

## Heart Screening


Calon Hearts, through its charitable heart screening programme, has already established the benefit
of screening, having identified many people with life-changing and life-limiting cardiac conditions.
As part of a strategic reorganisation, Calon Hearts is going to continue this important work to save
lives throughout the country.

## Latest News

Keep up to date with the latest from Calon Hearts. From upcoming screening events and charity
initiatives to stories from the communities we support, this is where we share news about our work
helping to keep more hearts beating.

At least 12 seemingly healthy young people die every week in the UK from heart conditions they
didn’t even know they had. Our mission is simple; to reduce this number so that no family loses a
loved one to a heart condition that could have been detected and managed.

Calon Hearts, through its charitable heart screening programme, has already established the benefit
of screening, having identified many people with life-changing and life-limiting cardiac conditions.
As part of a strategic reorganisation, Calon Hearts is going to continue this important work to save
lives  throughout the country.

**Sudden Cardiac Death in the young is an under-recognised health problem and tragedy in the UK. It
is estimated that at least 12 deaths per week are a result of SCD in the young. Furthermore, a
significant proportion of these deaths are preventable by simple screening with an ECG and
echocardiogram. **

## Our Mission


We are Calon Hearts UK, Wales's leading heart screening and defibrillator charity. We're on a
mission to ensure that every community across Wales has a defibrillator, that more people are
CPR-trained and that everyone has access to our heart screening programme. This is because today in
the UK, 480 people will die from a heart attack or circulatory disease. And at least 12 seemingly
healthy young people die every week in the UK from an undiagnosed heart condition. Our mission is
simple: to reduce this number so that no family loses a loved one to a heart condition that could
have been detected and managed. We’re committed to providing services that help minimise the risk of
people dying due to an unknown heart condition.

## Our Services


Accessibility to a defibrillator is key to saving a life. Each minute that is wasted reduces the
chances of saving that life by 10%. Therefore, it is our mission to ensure that nobody is further
than 100 metres away from a fully working publicly accessible defibrillator.

In order to fulfil this mission, we need your support to place more of these lifesaving devices
throughout the country.

## Heart Screening


Calon Hearts, through its charitable heart screening programme, has already established the benefit
of screening, having identified many people with life-changing and life-limiting cardiac conditions.
As part of a strategic reorganisation, Calon Hearts is going to continue this important work to save
lives throughout the country.

## Latest News

Keep up to date with the latest from Calon Hearts. From upcoming screening events and charity
initiatives to stories from the communities we support, this is where we share news about our work
helping to keep more hearts beating.

At least 12 seemingly healthy young people die every week in the UK from heart conditions they
didn’t even know they had. Our mission is simple; to reduce this number so that no family loses a
loved one to a heart condition that could have been detected and managed.

Calon Hearts, through its charitable heart screening programme, has already established the benefit
of screening, having identified many people with life-changing and life-limiting cardiac conditions.
As part of a strategic reorganisation, Calon Hearts is going to continue this important work to save
lives  throughout the country.

**Sudden Cardiac Death in the young is an under-recognised health problem and tragedy in the UK. It
is estimated that at least 12 deaths per week are a result of SCD in the young. Furthermore, a
significant proportion of these deaths are preventable by simple screening with an ECG and
echocardiogram. **

**We protect, life, property, and continuity of operations**

Doberman Emergency Management prepares our clients to face any crisis head on. In a world of ever

training. Our work keeps an emergency from becoming a disaster.

for comprehensive emergency management support. Our expert team delivers tailored assessments,
cutting-edge training, and integrated crisis response strategies to safeguard your patrons, staff,
and brand. Experience next-level security planning with custom evacuation videos for stadiums and
brand protection strategies, all backed by real-world expertise.

[Experience Doberman’s Enhanced Safety Approach][54]

Transform your university's emergency readiness with our comprehensive campus safety solutions. We
deliver leading school emergency planning, response strategies, and reunification protocols tailored
for education. From campus-wide Emergency Operations Plans to crisis response training, we cover all
aspects of campus safety. Our all-hazards approach, rooted in real-world expertise, protects your
entire academic community. We support all levels of education from universities to K-12 districts.
Revolutionize your institution's readiness with Doberman – safeguarding your campus from active
shooters to natural disasters.

installations. We craft bespoke crisis protocols, state-of-the-art risk assessments, and dynamic
incident management strategies engineered for intricate, confidential settings. From digital defense
to hazardous materials readiness, our holistic methodology dovetails with your current systems.
Harnessing tactical acumen, healthcare know-how, and innovative tech solutions, we bolster your
safeguards against emerging perils. Develop operational resilience with us.

[Learn How to Collaborate with Doberman][56]

Our seasoned professionals equip local governments, businesses, and organizations with innovative
tools to navigate crises effectively. From crafting multi-hazard response plans to conducting
realistic drills, we support communities for diverse challenges. Our expertise spans natural

U.S. Department of Energy’s Lawerence Berkeley National Laboratory has unique hazard mitigation
requirements. Doberman provided a comprehensive hazard vulnerability report with an
analytically-backed dashboard which supports both planning and response considerations. Our team
conducted on-site interviews, aggregated intelligence through data science, and lead hazard

Stadium Security - Comprehensive Emergency Management Support**

C-Suite members, maintains emergency plans and live situational awareness dashboards.

Best Practice in Emergency
Response during Urban War**

to NATO’s Special Environments Panel. This is in correlation with our work with USMC, enhancing

operations. Doberman provides training, environmental consultation, emergency services best
practices during times of war, and writing capabilities to our military partners.

# In less than one hour, anyone can learn
# how to stop life-threatening bleeding.

[Learn more][14]

STOP THE BLEED^{®}is an official program of the U.S. Department of Defense

The program is designed to train and equip the public to be able to treat traumatic injuries
involving severe bleeding until the first responders arrive.

The program is based on lessons learned by the DoD during the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan on how
best to control severe bleeding.

## Know How to Take Action

[Be the First to Act in Emergencies]

### Be the First to Act in Emergencies

No matter how fast professional emergency responders arrive, bystanders will always be first on the
scene. 

[Every Minute Counts]

### Every Minute Counts

A person experiencing life-threatening bleeding can die from blood loss within minutes, before first
responders arrive.

[Anyone Can Learn]

### Anyone Can Learn

A bystander with STOP THE BLEED^{®} training can slow or stop blood loss to keep someone alive until
first responders arrive.

[STOP THE BLEED®]

## Why It’s Important?

### 3-5 minutes

Someone can bleed out within minutes.

### 7-10 minutes

**Urban first responder** arrival can take up to 15 minutes.

### 30-45 minutes

**Rural first responder** arrival can take up to 45 minutes.

### 40%

Trauma-related deaths worldwide due to bleeding out.

### #1

**The number 1 cause** of preventable death after injury is bleeding.

### STOP THE BLEED^{®} is Worldwide

Training offered in **165 countries**.

## STOP THE BLEED^{®} An Official DoD Program

### Battlefield Insights

STOP THE BLEED^{®} is based upon lessons learned on the **battlefields of Iraq and Afghanistan** on
how best to control bleeding. [Battlefield Insights]

### Leading in Trauma Care

Today, DoD is a world leader in researching how best to provide for the immediate stabilization of
combat casualties, including how to treat **traumatic injuries** involving severe blood loss.
[Leading in Trauma Care]

### Military Lessons for Resilience

STOP THE BLEED^{®} is another example of military lessons used to help foster national resilience
and improved readiness for everyday emergencies. [Military Lessons for Resilience]

**What is Energy Healing?**
Energy healing is one of the oldest and most natural forms of healing we have. At its heart, it is
the understanding that we are all made of energy and that this energy can be guided, balanced and
restored to support wellbeing on every level: physical, emotional, mental and spiritual.

Usui Reiki is one of the most widely practised of all energy healing systems. Originating in Japan
in the early twentieth century, it has since spread across the world and been embraced by millions
of people seeking a gentle, non-invasive path to healing and inner peace. Reiki works by channelling
universal life force energy and directing it to where it is most needed.

Over the last twenty or so years, many other healing systems have been channelled, as you can see
from the array of attunements I offer! You can now attune to a vast amount of different energies for
so many different needs; healing, spiritual protection, abundance, ascension, kundalini awakening,
spiritual advancement, enhanced consciousness, connection to spirit guides…I could go on, there are
more than 1000 different attunements and systems on this website alone.

What I have always found so wonderful about energy work is its capacity to travel through time and
space. Distance is no barrier. The same universal energy that can be shared in a room can be sent
across the world with equal love and intention and this is the foundation of everything I offer
here.

**What is a Distant Attunement and How Does it Work?**
An attunement is a sacred energetic process by which a Reiki Master or energy practitioner opens and
aligns your energy channels so that you can receive and channel specific healing energies yourself.
Think of it like tuning a radio — the energy is already all around us, and an attunement simply
helps you receive it more clearly and fully.

Distant attunements work on exactly the same principle as distant healing — through the
understanding that energy transcends physical location, I am able to transmit the attunement energy
to you wherever you are in the world.

## What Is AVIRT? Active Violence Immediate Response Training

AVIRT (Active Violence Immediate Response Training) is the evolution of active shooter response.
Unlike outdated "run-hide-fight" protocols, AVIRT equips your team with an immediate, decisive
action framework — including critical Stop the Bleed medical intervention.

01
Situational Awareness & Recognition

Identify warning signs, behavioral cues, and environmental threats before violence escalates.

02
Immediate Decision-Making Framework

Move beyond passive response. Train your team to make split-second decisions that save lives.

03
Stop the Bleed Medical Response

Tourniquet application, wound packing, and hemorrhage control — the skills that bridge the gap
before EMS arrives.

04
Scenario-Based Live Exercises

Hands-on drills in realistic scenarios that build muscle memory and confidence under pressure.

BLEED^{®} Training Platform so people can sign up and take their class.

life-threatening bleeding.

health campaign.

networks.

AutoTQ® is the first and only automatic tourniquet that stops the bleed with audio instructions,
reusable and disposable components, and included training. Our mission is to provide responders and
bystanders with medical technology, including automatic tourniquets and emergency bleeding control
kits, backed by research and real-world use. Manufactured by Golden Hour Medical, Inc. AutoTQ is
Protected Under U.S. Patent No. 12,070,229 B1. AutoTQ is U.S. Utility Patent Pending.

# The Minutes Matter Project

### Helping bystanders stop blood loss and save lives

## Did you know?

#### **A person can bleed to death in as little as 3 to 5 minutes.**

Most people don't know that. They assume there's time —
time to call 911, time to wait, time for help to arrive.

But in rural areas like the Mendocino coast, EMS response can take 20 minutes or more.

That gap is the whole reason this project exists.

[James and Chloe, the founders of the non-profit]
[James and Chloe, the founders of the non-profit]

### Who we are

The Minutes Matter Project is a Mendocino County nonprofit founded by a local ER nurse, Chloe, and
her husband, James, an avid surfer and beloved high school English teacher. We're a small,
community-rooted team working to make sure help is never too far away, even in the most remote
corners of our coastline.

#### Our Mission

Serious injuries can happen anywhere on the Mendocino coast — on a hiking trail, at the beach, out
on the water — often in places where help is 30 minutes away. In those moments, the person closest
to the injury has the power to save a life, long before an ambulance can arrive.

The Minutes Matter Project places bleeding control kits at the most highly trafficked beaches on the
Mendocino Coast. Our kits are simple and easy to understand — no medical background required. With
the right supplies and a little confidence, anyone can stop a bleed and save a life.

The Minutes Matter Project is a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt nonprofit organization.
EIN: 42-3533712. Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.

Mendocino Coast. Our kits are simple and easy to understand — no medical background required. With
the right supplies and a little confidence, anyone can stop a bleed and save a life.

## Our "Be The Help" Campaign Supports U.S. Veterans and Pediatric Cancer Survivors

We carry Trauma Kits and emergency medical supplies produced by Military Veteran owned companies,
and all proceeds fund rehabilitation therapies for children severely affected by cancer and brain
tumors. Foundation ThinkAgain! is a 501c3  non-profit organization in operation since 2008...
because children can't fight the effects of cancer alone. 

#### Why Do We Need Public Access Emergency Response Trauma Kits?

The Department of Homeland Security's "STOP THE BLEED"  and FEMA's "BE THE HELP" campaigns, were
launched to encourage bystanders to step in and give aid, because sometimes injuries are too serious
to wait for help. Our trauma kits are built with tccc approved products and provide simple
instructions. We have first aid for schools, first aid for the workplace, and first aid for homes.
We carry stop the bleed kits, kits for law enforcement, kits to carry on a school bus, kits for work
safety and kits for storefronts and other businesses. Feel free to [**contact us**][44] to help you
choose an affordable, yet effective trauma kit for your organization. 

ThinkTraumaKits.com is a distributor of TRAMEDIC RESPONSE SYSTEMS, TACTICAL MEDICAL SOLUTIONS, NORTH
AMERICAN RESCUE and PHOKUS RESEARCH GROUP; all USA Veteran-Owned enterprises.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

## Mission Statement

disparities, and health outcomes in communities and populations worldwide, including the impact of
social conditions on the composition of patients seeking care in emergency departments. **][192]
